profile.headline: Software Engineer at Anrok | Ruby, Golang, Typescript
profile.summary: As a Senior Software Engineer with over 8 years of experience in building scalable web applications and optimizing databases, I've successfully led projects in the healthcare, finance, and education sectors. Skilled in Ruby, Golang, and JavaScript, I am passionate about solving complex technical challenges and driving innovation through collaboration.

projects.title: Hosted Data Provisioning (Redshift)
projects.description: Using data available from Canvas Data along with S3 and Redshift, the provisioning project keeps data from a client's Canvas instance up to date in a managed Redshift cluster.  This enables clients to perform analytics on their data without worrying about the heavy lifting needed to keep their data synchronized in a queryable environment.

projects.title: Canvas Snapshot (unofficial title)
projects.description: A project used to generate monthly reports from Canvas Data (a big data source).  These reports contain a number of different charts representing aggregated data for a client, as well as the aggregated data itself.
